newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Queensland dominate first session of Shield final.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Queensland dominate first session of Shield final.

text.p: Queensland opener Trevor Barsby has smashed a rapid half-century to help his side reach 100 for one at lunch on the first day of the Sheffield Shield final against Western Australia at the WACA Ground.
Barsby, playing his last match before retirement, scored 67 before he lofted a ball from off-spinner Bret Mulder down the ground only to hold out to Matthew Garnaut at long-on.
Queensland opener Matthew Mott was not out 28 at lunch alongside Jimmy Mayer, who had yet to score.
Queensland, who won the toss in fine conditions in Perth, must win the five-day match to capture the Shield title.
